features.titleHtml:
Luta ntango moke mpo na kobongisa.
Kutisa na kondima monene.
features.description: Screenshot (App) Maker ekendisi mosala oyo ezongela mbala na mbala na nsuka ya kokutisa app mpo ekoma nzela moko ya pamba mpe ya kitone.

cards.title: Tia ba screens ya app na yo awa.
cards.body: Importa ba screenshots, tia yango na layout ya ba appareils oyo ekonzi, mpe bongisa lisolo mobimba ya App Store na minoto moke.

cards.title: Designa mbala moko.
cards.body: Tia ba couleurs, ba layouts, misala ya appareil, ba types, mpe ba ombres na page nyonso, kasi tika message nyonso ezala ya sika.

cards.title: Ekondima na screen nyonso.
cards.body: Bongisa ba assets mpo na iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, Apple TV, mpe ba feature graphics kobanda na projet moko.

cards.title: Exporta package oyo ekonzi mpo na kokutisa.
cards.body: Rendera ba images ya haute résolution, bongisa ba fichiers ya lokalizasion, mpe funga metadata ya App Store oyo okonzelaki na archive moko ya pamba.

ollama.title: Tutoriel ya installation ya Ollama
ollama.subtitle: Connecta Screenshot (App) Maker na instance na yo ya Ollama mpo na traduction ya AI mpe kosala texte.
requirements: Mac, Windows PC, to machine ya Linux mpo na kokendisa Ollama
Ollama eza installée mpe ezali kosala
iPhone/iPad na yo na réseau oyo moko na machine ya Ollama (esengeli)
steps: Installer Ollama: telecharger mpe installer Ollama mpona OS na yo.
Banda Ollama: kokende na ollama serve (toa fungola application Ollama na macOS).
Kozwa modèle: kokende na ollama pull llama3.2 (toa modèle oyo olingi).
Tala soki ezali kosala: kokende na ollama run llama3.2 mpe esaya prompt moko.
Luka adresse ya serveur na yo: koma LAN IP ya ordinateur na yo (na ndakisa 192.168.0.10).
Salela yango na application: na réglages ya Screenshot (App) Maker, tia Host na http://<LAN-IP>:11434.
ollama.notesTitle: Bikoma mpe ndenge ya kosilisa mikakatano
notes: Soki application ekoki kokutana te, tala soki téléphone mpe ordinateur na yo ezali na réseau Wi-Fi moko.
Tala soki port 11434 efungwami na firewall na yo.
Soki olingi osalela serveur ya mosika (home PC, VPS), esengeli ofungola port na ndenge ya sécurisé (VPN ezali kolingama).
ollama.ctaBody: Zonga na application, esaya connexion, mpe banda na monoko moko.

privacy.title: Politique ya sekreti
privacy.intro: Politique ya sekreti oyo elobi ndenge Screenshot (App) Maker ("App") azali kosala na ba données ya bazoli.
summary: Compte te. Analytics te. Tracking te.
Ba fichiers na yo mpe ndenge otekisi yango ekotikala na appareil na yo, soki oponi kokitisa yango na serveur na yo ya Ollama te.
Soki ozali kosalela Ollama, texte ekokende kaka na adresse ya serveur oyo otelemisi.

sections.title: Kobongisa ba informations
body: App oyo ekobongisa te, ekobatela te, mpe ekotinda te ba informations ya moto moko na ba serveurs na biso.
Screenshots, templates, mpe bafoto oyo ekatami bakelami mpe basengelisami na ekipam na yo.

sections.title: Kozwa nzela ya Bakanda mpe Bafoto
body: App ekoki kosenga kozwa nzela ya kofungola app ya Bakanda to bibliothèque na yo ya bafoto mpo ekota na screenshots.
Bafoto oyo ekoti babongisami na ekipam moko moko, mpe basengelisami te na nzela ya automatique.

sections.title: Traduction AI (Ollama)
body: Soki olongoli AI mpo na kosala texte to traduction, App ekoki kotinda texte na serveur Ollama oyo osilisi kokongola (na ndakisa, ordinateur na yo moko).
Biso tobongisaka te mpe tozwanaka te trafic na yo ya Ollama, mpe App ekotaka te mpe ebombaka te texte oyo AI esalaki.

sections.title: Bisaleli ya Basusu
body: App esalelaka te analyse ya basusu, SDK ya publicités, to technologie ya kotondola.

sections.title: Bongoli
body: Tokoki kobongisa Politique ya Secret oyo na ntango na ntango. Bongoli ekomonana na page oyo.

sections.title: Kontakta
body: Soki ozali na mituna mpo na Politiki ya Bokonzi ya Secret oyo, tinda biso message na adresi ya email oyo ekomi na lisumu ya App Store.
